title:
Populate application state with the retrieved sample questions for the type specified in the payload.
Listens to `Reliability.AlertDetailPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET`, `Reliability.CaseDetailPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET`
Payload takes the following arguments:
 `typeToGenerateQuestions`: The chart dynamic component to trigger a data request for.
 `entityId`: The id of the entity of type `typeToGenerateQuestions` to generate sample questions for.
 `entityIdPageParamName`: Field to specify to use the page param with the provided name to retrieve the entityId.
                          Only used if `entityId` is not provided.

Also listens to `Reliability.GenerativeApplicationState.APPLICATION_STATE_INITIALIZE` and waits for setting questions in state
if application state has not been initialized.
name: GenerativeAIGenerateSampleQuestionsEpic
